title: JAILBREAKS ON VISION LANGUAGE MODEL VIA MULTIMODAL REASONING
reasoning: The paper focuses on safety-alignment jailbreaking (adversarial attacks) in Vision-Language Models. While it utilizes safety datasets that include categories like 'hate speech' and mentions 'ethical questions' in the context of dataset splits, the core research is about the technical capability of bypassing safety filters for harmful content, rather than an evaluation of religion, spiritual traditions, or formal moral/ethical frameworks.
